q: 1. The presence of more than ........ % of members in Nepal engineering council is considered as the fulfillment of minimum quorum.
explain: A meeting is valid only when more than half (50%) of the members are present; this is the minimum quorum.

q: 2. In Nepal, which of the following act contains the provisions on health and safety of the workers?
explain: The Labour Act specifically outlines statutory regulations concerning occupational health, safety measures, and workplace environments for workers.

q: 3. Workers are not allowed to work continuously more than
explain: As per the Labour Act, a worker must be given a break after continuous work of 5 hours.

q: 4. The minimum qualification required for professional engineer is ........
explain: The answer key gives master in engineering. Qualification rules have been amended over time, so verify against the current NEC regulation.

q: 5. The minimum qualification required for foreign engineer is ........
options: bachelor in engineering and 5 years experience
bachelor in engineering and 10 years experience
master in engineering and 5 years experience
master in engineering and 5 years experience
explain: As per the answer key, a foreign engineer needs a bachelor's degree plus 10 years of experience. Options c and d are identical in the book.

q: 6. Nepal Engineering Council regulation, 2057 is effective from
explain: The Nepal Engineering Council Regulation, 2057, came into effect on 2057/3/8 B.S., as per NEC records.

q: 7. The Nepal Engineers' Association was established in
explain: Nepal Engineers' Association (NEA) was established in the year 2024 BS (1968 AD) as a professional body of engineers in Nepal.

q: 8. NEC को बैठकमा कति प्रतिशत भन्दा बढी सदस्यको संख्या उपस्थिपत भएमा परिषद्‌को बैठकको लागि गणपूरक संख्या पुगेको मानिन्छ ?
explain: A simple majority of more than 50% of total sitting members is required to meet the legal quorum for holding NEC council meetings.

q: 9. The number of members in NEA are ........
explain: As per the answer key, the answer is 25.

q: 10. NEA was established in ........
explain: The Nepal Engineers' Association was established in 1962 AD, per the answer key.

q: 11. The number of countries in which Nepal Engineering Council has recognized the academic institutions are (September, 2013)
explain: According to NEC records up to September 2013, engineering academic institutions across 40 countries were formally recognized for engineering registration.

q: 12. As per Nepal Engineering Council Act 2055, the tenure of the members of the council is
explain: The NEC Act 2055 prescribes a tenure of 4 years for the members of the Council.

q: 13. If the registration of an engineers is cancealed from NEC his name will be registerered or not if engineer is ready to register his name (दफा)-18 NEC, regulution
explain: Under Section 18 of NEC Regulation, re-registration/restoration is permissible subject to meeting council conditions and approval.

q: 14. The minimum qulification required for a professional engineer is
explain: Registration as a Professional Engineer requires higher educational background, typically specified as Master's degree in Engineering alongside professional practice experience.

q: 15. The registration book for general and professional engineers is written in Nepali language while for foreginer engineer
explain: The official register for foreign engineers is maintained in the English language.

q: 16. Nepal engineering council is an autonomous body formed under NEC act in
explain: NEC was legally established as a statutory autonomous body under the Nepal Engineering Council Act, 2055 BS.

q: 17. Which one is not concerned with the NEC
options: accreditation of certificates of academic qualifications
explain: Granting legal sanction/permission to open academic engineering colleges lies with Universities and Ministry authorities, not NEC direct regulatory mandate.

q: 18. Membership categorized by Nepal Engineering Council for registration is
explain: NEC categorizes registered members as General Engineer, Professional Engineer, and Non-Nepali Registered Engineer; 'Professional Engineer' is the correct categorized membership among the options.

q: 19. The Nepalese engineers day is ........
explain: Engineers' Day in Nepal is observed on 3rd Shrawan.

q: 20. The registrar of NEC is nominated by ........
explain: The registrar is nominated by the Government of Nepal.

q: 21. The primary function of Nepal engineering council is to
options: exercise disciplinary control on the professional conduct
conduct seminars and organize consultations of professional development
explain: NEC's core mandate is to regulate the engineering profession, including exercising disciplinary control over the professional conduct of registered engineers.

q: 22. Labour act was introduced in B.S
explain: The Nepal Labour Act was introduced in 2048 B.S.

q: 23. Which organization is responsible for the licensing of new engineers?
explain: The answer key gives Ministry of education. In practice NEC registers engineers, so verify this one.

q: 24. NEC publishes the name of registered engineer ........
explain: As per the answer key, neither listed interval applies.

q: 25. The foreign engineer will be registered in NEC for ........
explain: As per the answer key, a foreign engineer's registration period is 6 years.

q: 26. Which of the following association members must not have registered their names in Nepal Engineering council to conduct engineering activities?
explain: As per the answer key, members of DEAN are the exception that need not register their names with NEC to conduct engineering activities.

q: 27. Which Ministry of Government of Nepal deals with Civil Engineering group of Nepal Engineering service?
options: Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport
explain: The Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport (MoPIT) serves as the cadre-controlling ministry for Civil Engineering service.

q: 28. Engineering profession needs cooperation with the profession of:
explain: Comprehensive multidisciplinary projects require cross-functional cooperation across legal, financial, and safety/medical fields.

q: 29. The registered engineer in Nepal Engineering Council should have to renew their registration in:
explain: General Engineer registration under NEC Act is a lifetime registration and does not mandate periodic renewal (unlike foreign engineers).

q: 30. The number of NEA members nominated for NEC is ........
explain: As per the answer key, 5 NEA members are nominated to the council.

q: 31. Every practicing engineer in Nepal must be registered legally in:
explain: As per the answer key, every practicing engineer must be legally registered with the Nepal Engineer's Association.

q: 32. The numbers of clause in Nepal engineering council act is ........
explain: As per the answer key, the act has 38 clauses.

q: 33. Provision for professional code of conduct of engineers in Nepal is made in detail in:
explain: The explicit operational code of conduct for registered engineers is detailed under the Nepal Engineering Council Rules/Regulations 2057.
